info.name: NASA NeoWs - Near Earth Object Web Service Browse Lookup API
Lookup a specific asteroid by SPK-ID

params.name: asteroidId
params.description: NASA JPL small body (SPK-ID) for the asteroid.

params.name: api_key
params.description: NASA API key. Defaults to DEMO_KEY if omitted.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information for a specific near Earth object using its NASA JPL small body (SPK-ID) identifier.
